# Gramlot 0.3.19

- Add a separate Python PageStore recipe with a reactive Bag and named controllers/formulas.
- Synchronize client and server paths with dataBinder: initial snapshot, typed changes and binder-origin echo suppression.
- Share one primary WebSocket across Gramlot iframe and popup descendants, including correlated RPC, publications and recursive lifecycle cleanup.
- Publish to a same-owner PageStore or back to a connected client; subscribed controllers receive validated sender pageId metadata. Publication acknowledgement confirms acceptance, not controller completion.
- Require Bag JS 0.11.1, which preserves deletion origin.

This first implementation uses process-local stores and synchronous server recipes. It does not provide persistence, reconnection/replay, cross-process routing or server-side dataRpc/dataResolver execution.
